tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sprul pa'i sku mchog skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa nas bka'i 'phrin yig ma bu 'byor ba'i gsung lan a mra'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta skye 'gro la ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyis bgrangs pa'i grangs bzhi stong go drug mchis pa'i nang gsel pa naṣ+ṭa me tog phreng ba can/ ud+diṣ+ṭa chig stong dang chig brgya don gcig pa/ yang ba'i bya ba gcig yang ba nyi ma'i grangs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i prastā ras mdzes par brgyan pa'o// ༄༅// yas+yanāmo3k+ṣarāṇāmalibal+lakīḥt+r+yādarāgraṅgulairbar+t+titaṃmātratā/ swastishān+tir+bhawānāṃyashogītayonit+yadhenus+t+rayairat+natepālaya// ༄༅// gang mtshan mi 'gyur phreng ba'i pi wang rgyud// dad gsum sor mo'i rtse yis bsgyur tsam gyis// srid zhi'i bde legs snyan glur rtag 'jo ba// dkon mchog gsum gyis khyed la skyongs shig gu// skyes sbyangs mi dman sna tshogs las pa yis// legs par bdar ba'i blo gros mi sbyin skyes// rig pa'i gzhung mkhar bgrod pas mi ngal ba'i// ngo mtshar gtam gyi 'od stong ldan pa gang*// rgyal bstan mkhas pa'i bgyi bas bskyang bzod pa'i// sdom brtson khyod sku bskal par 'tsho gzhes su// 'degs la legs bris rdzing nas 'dab stong pas// khyed zhabs nges par lhags snyam gang yin der// dbyar skyes tshal du ring skyes rkang pas 'thung*// yal 'dab gzhon nu rnam par g.yo ba'i phang*// gzhan gsos bu mo lang tshos rgyags pa'i mgrin// dgung char zim bu phyogs bteg 'di skad mol// las bzang skyed byed dam ma'i smon lam gyi// rgyang glu snyan dgus mgron du bos pa'i bu// rgyal gsung thar pa'i srog 'tsho'i dga' ston la// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i skal bzang khyod nyid khums// dpag bsam gtong phod rmad byung chos kyis dbul// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan bsil yang las nyon gyi// gdung 'phrog bsil zer spro min mkhas dbang khyod// sbyin bzhi'i gtong phod che bas khyad par 'phags// gcig tu skye 'gro rjes gzung bzo gso'i rig

/tshig don 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i sgra tshad gzhung*// mngon mtho nges legs lam ston mtshan nyid sngags// mtha' drug dgongs zab mkhyen kyin 'doms ring nas// che ldan dga' ma'i rkang rtses bsnun phye ba'i// rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur legs sbyar brda'i// mya ngan med dpal 'dab ma grol ba las// gzugs rgyan gyis mtshan sbrang rtsi'i mgrin snyan bsgyur// gang dang chabs cig glegs bu phyag rgya'i rgya// lang tsho'i mdzes pa ma rnying ngom bzhin du// zla shel zhun ma'i tshon gyi co 'dri'i dar// lcags mchog srong 'khor bcas pa son pa na// phyogs der sngon med gtsug lag snang ba dkar// shar la mngon dga'i ro bdas myos pa'i sems// lta byed dbang po'i bar du gar byed la// rus pa'i ge sar gad mo 'byin nam snyam// 'di na tshogs gsum 'dus pa'i chos tshan 'gar// dpyad gsum rigs pa'i byi dor gyis bgrungs la// rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i ring 'tshor bsgrubs pa'i mthus// 'byung khams 'khrugs par ma bzod rnal du gnas// 'tshams 'dir gsung mchid phebs lan snye ma dag /rab spros dpag bsam shing rtser 'dzegs pa'i longs// bral yang thad so'i gsung lan a mra yi// rkang 'thung 'bras bu bsdus pa'i khud pa 'bul// de'ang mchog sprul dam pa'i legs gsungs stsal ba'i snying por/ tshig lhug pa'i skabs su sdeb sbyor gyi dgos pa med kyang tshig gong 'og dkrugs pa zhig 'dug pa 'di'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ bstan bcos rnams kyi rgyab yig phal cher la bstan bcos de dang de'i mtshan dngos de'i skad dod gang du bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan dgos zhes par/ gsung lan ni/ de dag 'ga' zhig ni/ bkas bcad bye brag tu rtogs byed chen po'ang nang du chos bsgyur lugs kyi skad dod dang bye brag rtogs byed chung ngu sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa dag las 'byung ba'i don ltar bod kyi skad la go bde ba'i phyir byas pa'ang 'byung ste/

de nyid las ji skad du/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni don dang yang mi 'gal la/ bod skad la yang gar bde bar gyis shig chos bsgyur ba la rgya gar gyi skad kyi go rim las mi bsnor ba bod kyi skad du bsgyur na don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing bde na ma bsnor bar sgyur cig bsnor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa cig yod na/ tshigs bcad la rtsa ba bzhi pa'am drug pa'ang rung ste/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang na gang bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur cig rkyang pa la ni don gang snyegs pa yan chad kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka la gar bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur cig skad gcig la ming du mar 'dren pa ni ltag 'og dang bstun la gar snyegs pa bzhin du ming thogs shig ces sogs 'byung ba'i lugs ltar byas pa'ang mang du 'byung ba sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgyur bstar byas pa rnams la gzigs pas thus/ 'ga' zhig ni/ brda sprod lugs kyi bzlas dbye'i tshig sdud kyi stobs kyis kyang 'byung ste/ ka lā pa las/ der dbyangs rab nyung snga mar te// gnyis kyis gang zhig mchod pa yang*// zhes bshad pa ltar tshig sdud de la'ang dbyangs nyung ba snga mar bzhag pa dang*/ mchod 'os snga mar bzhag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dper na/ ya ba/ nas dang*/ kha di ra/ sing lding ste/ nyung ba gong du btang ba'i bsdu ba byas pas ya wa khe de rau/ nas sing lding zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin du/ p+lak+ṣa n+ya gro dha zhes pa rab 'gyur dman 'gog dang*/ bud+dha bo dhi satwa/ zhes pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' lta bu ni/ dbyangs nyung ba dang*/ mchod 'os sngon du yod pa gnyis ka'i don tshang ba lta bu'o// yang*/ brāh+ma ṇa k+ṣa tri ya/ zhes pa bram ze rgyal rigs te dbyangs mang nyung mnyam yang gang mchod par 'os pa snga mar bzhag pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni/ de nyid las/ gang gis snga mar brjod byar 'gyur// de ni mi zad gyur par 'dod// ces tshig sdud de ma ning gi rtags ltar bsgrub byar bstan pa ni/

thog mar mi zad pa'i rtags bzhag pa/ u pa kum+bha nye ba'i bum pa dang*/ pra ti mo k+ṣa/ so sor thar pa dang*/ u pa sam+pan+na/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa ste/ pra ti dang*/ u pa sngon du bzhag pa lta bu dang*/ grangs snga ma can pa gnyis zhes pa gnyis pa'i bsdu bar/ da sha dika phyogs bcu zhes pa'i phyogs sngon du bzhag pa dang gzhi mthun pa'i tshig sdud kyi ma hā satwa dang ma hā kā la sogs shin tu mang po 'byung ba rnams legs sbyar skad lugs de ltar yod kyang bod skad la go bde ba'i ched du tshigs gong 'og dkrugs pa 'byung ba de ltar dang*/ bstan bcos sogs kyi ming dngos gong du bton pa ni de'i nang nas mchod par 'os pa'am brjod bya'i gtso bo sngon du bzhag pa'i dgos ched yin pa 'dra ste/ da ltar bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar du byas pa mang du 'byung ba'i phyir ro// yang dri ba bye brag rtogs byed sogs kyi skad dod 'di rnams ming tshig gang yin zhes par/ gsung lan ni/ bye brag tu rtogs byed dang*/ mu tig phreng ba dang*/ sna tshogs gsal ba 'di rnams/ phal cher ming gi mngon brjod la mtshams sbyor gyi cho ga byas pa'i ming yin yang*/ ming rkyang pa kho nar yang ma nges te/ 'ga' zhig tu ming rtags la si sogs byin pa dang byings la ti sogs kyi rkyen byin pa'i rjes kyang mang du yod pas tshig 'dres mar snang ngo*// yang dri ba pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum gyi dbye ba 'chi med mdzod du bshad pa de ma gtogs gzhan da ltar yod dam med/ yod na tshul ji lta bu yin no zhes par/ gsung lan ni/ spyir rtag gsum so so'i rnam dbye'i 'gyur tshul dang*/ gzhung las/ gang gi snga mar brjod byar 'gyur// de ni mi zad gyur par 'dod// de ni ma ning rtags su 'gyur// zhes pa'i nyer bsgyur dang bsdu ba sogs kyi sgo nas rtags ngos bzung 'gyur 'gro sogs ni brda sprod kyi gzhung nyid du gsal ba ltar yin la/

rtags gsum dbyangs gsal gyi mtha' can nges pa'i ngos gzung ni/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi legs bshad las/ pho'i rtags la ṛ yig ring po nas/ e yig snga ma'i bar gyi bzhi bor ba'i dbyangs bcu dang*/ gsal byed tsa dza ta da dha na sha ṣa sa ha ste bcu'i mtha' can rnams yod/ mo'i rtags la a thung ṛ thung l̥ thung ngu gnyis te bzhi bor ba'i dbyangs ā i gnyis u gnyis ṝ ste drug gi mtha' can srid/ gsal byed la tsa dza ta da na pa bha ra wa/ dro ba'i yi ge bzhi ste bcu gsum gyi mtha' can srid do// ma ning gi rtags la dbyangs a i u thung ngu gsum dang*/ dza ta na dha ra dro ba'i yi ge bzhi k+ṣa ste bcu'i mtha' can srid do// rtags gsum thun mong ba la dbyangs ṛ l̥ l̥̄ gsum po min pa'i bcu gcig gi mtha' can dang*/ ya yig bor ba'i gsal byed thams cad srid do zhes bshad/ 'di dag rgyas par ni slob dpon 'chi med seng ges byas pa'i ming dang rtags rjes su bstan pa 'chi ba med mdzod du bshad pa nyid ni bod du 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos kyi rgyal po lta bu ste 'di nyid gtso bor gzung*/ de'i 'grel pa paṇ+ḍi ta rab 'byor zla bas mdzad pa/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang pos stod cha bsdus te bod du mkho che ba btus nas bsgyur ba dang*/ sa paṇa gyis kyang de nyid gzhir bzhag pa'i tshig gi gter rnams mdzad kyang der rtags kyi dbye ba bod la mi 'byor bar dgongs la mdzad pa de tsam ma gtogs gzhan yod los 'gro mod kho bos ma mthong la/ phyis su da ltar mkhas dbang si tu rin po che nas bal yul nas rnyed pa'i rgya dpe bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gis byas pa shin tu rgyas pa zhig kyang 'byor bas 'grel pa 'dod 'jo rdzogs par bsgyur nas/ da ltar par dul bod pa'i skabs yin 'dug pa ha lam tsam mjal yang zhib pa zhus dag ma tshar bar du mjal rgyu ma byung ba glegs bam shin tu che ba gnyis tsam bzhugs pa sgra sgrub kyi cho ga phal cher tsan+d+ra pa'i cho gas byas pa zab rgyas zhig bzhugs 'dug

de ma yin pa'i yang 'chi med mdzod kyi skad dod dkyus su tshigs bcad dbang gis bod skad du 'khrugs can du yod pa/ skad dod so sor rang thad du phral nas rtags gsum gyi khyad par bcas bshad pa zhig mdzad pa de nyid go bde ba sogs kun la phan pa zhig 'dug pa/ de'ang da ltar par bsgrub pa'i skabs yin 'dug lags/ yang dri ba/ sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas gzhung du mi gsal ba'i phyed mnyam dang mi mnyam dang*/ dzā tir bcas pa'i sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad gsar bsgrigs bzo chog min zhes par/ gsung lan ni/ 'di dag gi prāstā ra phyed mnyam mi mnyam/ dzā ti rnams kyi prāstā ra sdeb sbyor gzhung du bkod pa ltar las/ mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta'i ngo mtshar rtogs byed kyi skabs dang 'dra ba'i nang gsal gzhung gis dngos zin min pa mang por spel ba bzos pa ni ma mthong la/ khyad par phyed mnyam la ni/ gzhung de nyid dper byas nas bkod pa ltar skad dod bsgrigs pa las gzhan bzo lugs ma mthong*/ 'on kyang mi mnyam pa'i nang gsal kha sgo la/ rkang pa yig brgyad dang po las// sa na min mtsho las ya kha sgo// zhes pa ltar yi ge brgyad kyi thog mtha'i yi ge re bor ba'i yi ge gsum po de la sa mtha' lci ba dang na kun yang ba gnyis med pa dang*/ mtsho ste prāstā ra bzhi pa'i gsum po la ya thog yang ba byas pa ni sdeb sbyor kha sgo ste/ de la gzhung gi dper brjod du rkang pa dang por ra yod kyang*/ sa na gang rung med pa'i yi ge gzhan gang rung byas pas rung bar gsung zhing*/ de bzhin byas pa dag kyang mchis te/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs kyi kha sgo'i sdeb sbyor yod pa rnams la'ang*/ dang por sa na med pa ma gtogs gzhan nges pa ma byas pa'i rjes mchis pa'i phyir/ gzhan la'ang des 'gre rung bar sems kyis de las gzhan pa'i rkang bzhi 'phel ba sogs la ni/ gzhung gi dper brjod ltar byed pa las/

de ltar ma yin pa ni sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrigs pa la'ang kho bos de sngon ma mthong zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan mdor bsdus phul ba lags so// slar yang 'dir smras pa/ mkhas khyod thams cad mkhyen rgyu gtsug lag 'ga'// sbyangs pa'i rjes su yi rang smreng sems kyang*// da dung sbyangs pas 'bras bus gzhan 'byung ba// shes bya'i gzhung gi khyad chos yin zhes thal// slad char thub pa'i chos dang sems can don// sgrub byed gzugs sku rab brling cho ga dang*// gsungs don mdor bsdus smras 'dis chog gam min// ji lta'i 'phrin yig rgyun chags stsol ba mkhyen// de skad zhu gsol bsung ldan chu skyes tshal// rnam gsal 'dren byed rkang drug 'bab stegs su// rnam dkar lha gos dzam+bu ka shun bcas// rnam mkhyen spyod rjes slob pa'i gyi na pas// rab byung 'dod par legs son zla ba'i mdzod// dbang thang lcags khams kyis bskyed mig gis thos// gro bzhin dga' mas nya rgyas 'dzum bsu dus// dga' ba gnyis par lhun grub steng nas so// zhes sga rag nyag bla brang gi sprul pa'i sku mchog gtsug lag kun la 'jug pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyi 'dren byed dkyus su ring ba'i bla chen skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa nas/ bka'i 'phrin yig ma bu stsal ba 'byor ba'i gsung lan a mra'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris te phul ba sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// zab mo'i don las brtsams pa'i gdams pa thar mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gdod nas dag pa kun khyab chos kyi sku// dge mtshan lhun grub chos 'byung longs spyod rdzogs// sna tshogs 'gro blor 'char ba sprul pa'i sku// dbyer med bla ma lha yis bdag byin rlobs// 'di na nges pa'i don la blo gzhol bas// gzung 'dzin 'ching ba rang grol rig pa 'dzin// grub pa'i yon tan dbang 'byor gang yin der// gnas lugs rtogs la bogs 'don mi dgos mod// gang de'i gsung bskul pad+ma'i dri bsung gis// bdag rgyud rkang drug snying la sim pa'i 'phral// gsung don ya ma brlar nyid mi 'gyur slad// lung don thos pa'i mching bu 'di skad gleng*// dman las chad 'phags sdom pa kun bskyed cing*// srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i yon tan gter// bla ma dkon mchog gsum po 'di nas gzung*// tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su gzung bar gtso// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rang bzhin 'khor ba las// yid 'byung bskyed nas dge sdig rnam par smin// rgyu 'bras bslu med thams cad mkhyen pa yi// khyad par chos su nges pa'i blang dor gces// mngon mtho nges legs 'jug pa'i sgo dang po// chos 'dul bslab gzhir khyad gsod mi bya bar// bag yod sems bsrung brtul zhugs tshun chad la// bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin phyir gces par gzung*// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyis bgrod gcig lam// gzhan don byang chub smon dang 'jug pa'i sems// rnam dag cho gas rgyal ba'i sras bskrun nas// de yi spyod tshogs kun la ci nus bslab// dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro rnams tshe rabs kyi// pha mar byas pa'i drin mtha' gzhal med phyir// byams brtses kun bslangs bdag gzhan mnyam rje yis// byang chub sems kyis bdag 'dzin mgo bo gnon// spyod pa'i ya gyal dran nyer la sogs pa'i// dmigs rnam kun la rtse gcig sems bsgrub phyir// 'phro rgod bying rmugs gnyen po gang 'tsham gyis// mtshan rtog med pa'i zhi gnas bsgom par gces// yan lag 'di dag phal cher mi mchog gis// bdag med shes rab bskyed pa'i don gsungs te// chos rab rnam 'byed med par nyon mongs rnams// gang phyir nye bar zhi ba'i thabs med phyir// de yi mi mthun phyogs gyur bdag lta ste// rang lus nyer len phung po la dmigs nas// nga bdag 'dzin par 'jug pa sun 'byin phyir// ma brtags rang dgar rtog pa'i 'dzin stangs can// bdag 'dzin drungs nas 'byin slad 'di ltar bsam// bdag ces bya ba ming ngam lus sam sems// ming ni glo bur btags te bdag ma yin// ming nyid rang gi ngo bos stong 'gyur na// de la bdag gi dngos po ji ltar rigs// lus ni skra nas rkang rtse'i bar brtags na// 'byung tshogs 'dus pa tho yor mir 'khrul bzhin// sha khrag rus par bsal ba'i lus dngos kyang*// mi rtag rang bzhin bdag tu ga la 'thad// sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste// 'das pa 'gags dang ma 'ongs skyes pa med// da lta'i sems la kha dog dbyibs kyi dngos// gang du'ang grub pa med phyir bdag ma grub// de lta'i tshul gyi rnam par dpyad nas ni// nga'o snyam pa'i gang zag bdag 'dzin spong*// gcig tu gzung ba phyi rol don nyid kyang*// thog ma med nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis// rnam par dkrugs pa'i sems nyid don snang tsam// de las phyi don snang ba 'khrul ngor te// dmyal ba la sogs rigs drug so so'i ngor// chu la sogs pa'i dngos po gcig nyid la// lcags bsregs la sogs yid ni tha dad phyir// rdul phran 'dus pa'i gong bu'i snang ba yang*// drug gi cig car sbyar ba'i rig pas kyang*// rnam par brtags na rdul bran yod min na// de 'dus pa yi dngos de ji ltar grub// des na don du snang ba blo nyid yin// snang ba de nyid phyi na med pa'i phyir// sems kyang phyi nang bar gsum gang du yang*// btsal na sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma rnyed na// byis pas rnyed pa mo gsham bu yi spun// sems nyid dang por skye ba'i rgyu yis stong*// skye ba med phyir bar du gnas pas stong*// gnas rgyu med phyir tha mar 'gag pas stong*// des na dus gsum kun gyis ma bcings pa// de ni dmigs med stong pa nyid yin no// gal te gnas lugs yod pa ma grub na// yod pa bkag pa'i zlas drangs med pa'am// yod med gnyi ga bkag pa'i gnyis min yang*// grub pa min phyir mtha' bzhi spros bral du// blo 'das gang de dbu ma'i lta ba'o// spros bral de yi rang nyid rtsol med du// klod na ngo mtshar ltad mo mang drags kyang*// skabs su bying rgod spang ba'i gnyen po bsten// g.yeng bral bsgom du med pa'i rang bzhin skyongs// de ltar theg pa che lam rim can nam// cig car 'jug pa'i gang zag gang ltar yang*// tshe gcig mchog gi dngos grub sgrub 'dod pas// gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bslab// de yi thog mar smin byed dbang bskur blang*// de med lam bsgom rang gzhan dmyal ba'i rgyu// gsungs phyir dbang thob dam tshig bsrung bar gces// dam tshig la gnas skal ldan skyes bu des// dbang dus skyes pa'i lta ba goms bya ste// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad kyang*// sems nyid lhan skyes ye shes rol pa'i rtsal// shes phyir stong nyid lta ba gces bya ste// dang por chos kun stong pa nyid bsgoms nas// lus can rnams kyi dri ma rab bkrus nas// lus sogs stong par gyur pa'i zhing sa la// blo dang ldan pas sa bon gdab gsungs phyir// lta bas gtan la phab ste dpyad 'jog gi

/bsgom tshul dbu ma'i skabs dang mtshungs pa nyid// de nas gsang sngags thabs lam la 'jug ste// bla med rnal 'byor sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang*// lam byed bzhi dang sbyor tshul mkhas par bslab// de nas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rnal 'byor gyis// yang dag ye shes bskyed thabs du ma zhig /rgyud sde rgya mtshor gsungs kyang rang rang gi /thad kar shes par bya las spro nus min// gang phyir 'dir ni kun la 'jug rung phyir// tshig dbang bzhi pa thob pa'i rgyun de nyid// nyams su blang tshul mdo tsam brjod na ni// rgyud chen rnams las mtshon bya mtshon byed du// gsungs pa'i mtshon bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam par rig pa yi// rtog pa kun gyis ma bsgribs stong pa nyid// mtha' bral stong pa nyid do de nyid kyang*// yan lag bdun ldan sangs rgyas nyid du bzhed// de nyid mtshon par byed pa'i dbang bzhi'i lam// nyams su blang tshul bsam gtan chos ldan pas// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos su snang ngo cog /rang sems nyid du nges shes bskyed nas ni// de yi mtshan nyid gsal bar rang bzhin stong*// ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med brjod bral te// gdod nas sku bzhir rnam par dag pa'i bdag /nges par gnas pa lam du byed dus 'dir// lha sku zhal sbyor steng du ngo sprad na// rang nyid lha sku zhal phyag rnam pa can// snang stong bden med sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan ltar// gsal la ma 'gags snang de sprul pa'i sku// sems rgyud 'dzag med lhan skyes bde ba che'i// rnam par shar ba ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs// bltas pas bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa kun gyis ma bsgribs stong pa nyid// mkha' bzhin dri ma kun bral chos kyi sku// de gsum ldog tshul sgo nas tha dad kyang*// mar me mar me'i gsal ba ji bzhin du// so sor dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku'o// zung 'jug sems nyid gshis lugs gang du yang*// grub pa med kyang bde ba chen po'i gdangs// ma 'gags rtsal du sna tshogs cir snang yang*// zung 'jug blo 'das brjod bral chen por skyongs// de rgyun rtag tu bskyangs pas mtshon byed pa'i// dri bral ye shes rgyud la bskyed nas des// mtshon bya mthar thug don gyi ye shes che// 'dren byed tshul chen 'di la nan tan bya// mnyam gzhag rjes thob rnal 'byor thams cad du// phyi nang gzugs su cir snang lha'i 'khor lo// snang stong zung 'jug lam dang 'bras bu'i chos// dag pa'i bdag nyid zhal phyag rnam par skyongs// bzlas brjod sgrar grags de yi rang bzhin nyid// skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i sngags kyi gdangs// dran rtog 'gyu ba thams cad rang rig pa// rang gsal ye shes chen por legs bskyangs na// srid gsum dag pa'i 'khor lor shar ba la// 'khor 'das spang blang dgag sgrub ci byar yod// lta bsgom spyod pa spyad dgu'i dge rtsa rnams// zung 'jug 'pho bral mchog gi go 'phang du// bsngos pas sgo gsum dge ba gang byas kyang*// nam yang 'dzad med 'tshang rgya'i rgyur 'gyur ro// 'dir 'bad dge bas srid dang zhi ba'i mthar// mi gnas mya ngan 'das gyur de srid du// mdo sngags rgyal ba'i gsung gi gces mdzod rnams// yongs bzung bdag med smra ba'i nyi mar shog

/khyad par tshe gcig phyag chen mchog gi dngos// thob byed riṃg 'dziṃn sdom pas lus ngag yid// legs sdom gsang chen choṃs la dbaṃng 'byor zhing*// phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi chad par shog /ces zab mo'i don las brtsams pa'i gdams pa thar mchog bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gang shar rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa rmor tsha sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ chos tshul smra ba'i gzugs brnyan pa ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i khyu mchog gi bgrang gzhi shar ba'i tshes dge bar/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tho chung bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ spyod pa'i rgyud kyi skabs kyi mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sems ci tsam 'dod par brtan pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ slob mas bsgrims te byang chub kyi// sems ni kun tu dag par bya// gang tshe dmigs pa rnams kyis ni// slob ma nam yang mi g.yo ba// de tshe nam mkha' lta bu ni// dri med kun tu dag pa yin// zhes so// de ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul rgyud las gsungs pa'i don mdor bsdu na/ 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ ci mtshan ma rnams ni gang las byung*/ bdag gi lus sam/ sems sam/ yid gang las byung*/ de la lus ni las las skyes pa/ 'byung ba dang khu khrag sogs 'dus pa la rag las pa/ phyi rol bems chos rtswa shing bong ba lta bu ngo bo nyid kyis bya ba med pa blun pa/ phyi rol gyi rnam pa lta bu bzos byas pa'i gzugs lta bu brtag par bya ste/ bzos byas pa'i gzugs de la gzhan dag gis brdeg pa'am bshig pa'am bsreg pa sogs ji ltar bgyis kyang mi dga' ba cung zad kyang med la/

de la bza' btung la sogs pas bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang du bstabs kyang dga' bar 'gyur ba'ang med do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i gzugs de la rang gi nga rgyal gyis kun nas bslang ba'i phyin ci log gi rtog pas brnyas pa'am/ gus par byed pa'i mi de ni byis pa'i rang bzhin can no// ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i gzugs de la rang gi nga rgyal gyis kun nas bslangs te phyin ci log tu brtag pa'o snyam du lus la lus kyi rjes su song ba'i dran pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa sgyu ma lta bu'o// sems ni ngo bo nyid med cing mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ 'das pa'i sems 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ma skyes/ da ltar ba'i sems rang gi ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan ma dang bral ba lta bu'o snyam du bsam par bya'o// yid ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can gyi rnam shes te/ de ni byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams yid mtshan ma dang bcas par rtog ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa ma yin par kun tu rtog pa ste de ni ma skyes pa'o zhes bsams na mtshan ma dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par 'gyur te/ der bden par 'dzin pa'am blos btags pa tsam du shes par bya ste/ rgyud de nyid las/ de bas rnam pa thams cad du// stong nyid rtag tu dran par bya// zhes bya ba'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa ste nam mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas par gyur pa na/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang sngags rnams mngon du phyogs shing gzhol bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i don du snyeg go /zhes mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshul gyi tho chung 'di'ang dge slong byams pa bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng du bris pa'o// // ༄༅// rdo rje nag po chen po'i rtsa sngags kyi spel tshig las brtsams pa'i gsung lan rin chen snang gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud de// bstan srung rdo rje nag po che'i// rtsa sngags spel tshigs las brtsams pa'i// dris lan rin chen snang gsal 'degs// de'ang bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa gur gyi mgon po'i rnal 'byor gyi bsnyen par bzhugs pa'i skabs/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi las sngags spel tshig can bzla ba'i tshe/ spel tshig re re bzhin sbyor mi nus pas/ dī na mi ke na mā ra ya zhes pa'i gong du spel tshig gcig sbyar bas thus zhes pa 'di la nges pa mchis sam zhes gsungs par/ lan ni/ rtsa sngags 'di nyid kyi dkyus su bstan pa'i spel tshig ni/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa byed pa'i gdug pa can la spel tshig dngos su yod kyang*/ dmigs bsal gyi tshe gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ kha kha khā hi man chad kyi sngon du gnod byed ces sam/ dgra bgegs zhes sam/ byad ma zhes sogs skabs su gang babs re re bzhin spel tshig sbyar te/ dper na gnod byed kha kha/ gnod byed khā hi khā hi/ gnod byed mā ra mā ra/ gnod byed gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gnod byed ban+dha ban+dha/ gnod byed ha na ha na/ gnod byed da ha da ha/ gnod byed pa tsa pa tsa/ gnod byed dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces thams cad la 'dogs pa mdzad/ de ltar mi nus pas gzhan rnams dkyus ltar las spel tshig mi sbyor bar pa tsa pa tsa zhes pa'i rjes su gnod byed dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gdags pas thus zhes gsung rgyun la mchis mod/ mtha' ma gcig pu la spel tshig 'dogs pa 'di la dpyad na/ dkyus kyi tshig dang cung zad mi 'grigs par mngon te/ ci'i phyir na/ rgyud nas gsungs pa'i spel tshig dmigs bsal can ni/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭān zhes pa 'di/ bod skad du/ gdug pa can 'di rnams zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ rang re rnams kyis kyang de dang mnyam du sbrel nas/ dmigs bsal gyi spel tshig der gdags dgos kyi/ thams cad kyi mthar btags pa 'di 'thad pa ma mngon te/

kha kha khā hi sogs kyi sngags don ni gdug pa can 'di rnams zo zo/ za ru chug gnyis sam/ zo zhig gnyis/ sod gnyis sogs sngags don la yod pa de/ bya byed las gsum dang sbyar na/ zo zo/ gang za na/ gdug pa can 'di rnams/ za ru chug za ru chug gang za ru bcug na gdug pa can 'di rnams/ zhes pa lta bur 'byung dgos pa'i phyir/ des na thams cad kyi mtha' ma la spel tshig zur ba zhig byas pa de ni/ gong gi las la bskul ba'i tshig de rnams dang mi 'brel ba'i phyir/ 'o na sngags kyi grangs 'gro ba dang brjod bde ba'i phyir spel tshig dmigs bsal lan gcig tsam 'dogs mos pas gang du gdags par bgyi snyam na/ rgyud nas bstan pa'i dmigs bsal/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭān zhes pa de'i rjes thogs su/ gnod byed thams cad ces sam/ dgra bgegs thams cad ces sam/ byad ma thams cad ces sam/ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma thams cad ces pa lta bu skabs su gang bab zhig lan gcig tsam sbyar na sngags 'don pa la'ang bde ba dang*/ rigs pa la'ang 'thad che ba mngon no// de bzhin du rmi lam ngan pa byung ba'i tshe lta bu la'ang*/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭān/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad kha kha khā hi sogs dang*/ gdon che ba'i skabs su/ gdon bgegs 'byung po thams cad kha kha khā hi sogs man chad dkyus bzhin bya/ des na rtsa sngags kyi spel tshig sbyor lugs 'di bzhin byas na rang lugs la 'thad che ba mngon no// de dag gi don yang shā sa na'i sngags bod skad du bsgyur ba 'di'i don go na thams cad shes par 'gyur te/ de'ang 'di ltar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya zhes pa ni/ oṃ dpal nag po chen po/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi zhes pa ni/ bstan pa la nye bar 'tshe bar byed pa/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma kā lo ma yaṃ i daṃ zhes pa/ 'di phyi ma min pa'i dus 'di dang 'dir/ rat+na tra yā ya/ dkon mchog gsum la/ a ba kā ri ṇāṃ zhes pa/ gnod par byed pa/ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā zhes pa/

gal te byung na dam bca' dran par gyis la de'i tshe/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭ+ran kha kha zhes pa/ gdug pa can 'di rnams zo zo/ khā hi khā hi ni/ za ru chug za ru chug mā ra mā ra ni/ sod sod/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ni/ zung zung*/ ban+dha ban+dha ni/ chings chings/ ha na ha na ni/ snun snun/ da ha da ha ni/ sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa ni/ tshos tshos/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa ni/ nyi ma gcig gis gsod par gyis/ zhes pa'i don can du 'gyur ba'i phyir spel tshig sbyor lugs kyang de bzhin byas pas/ gdug pa can 'di rnams dang*/ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma thams cad/ zo zo zhes sogs 'byung bas tshig sbyor legs pa dang*/ las la bskul ba'i tshig rnams kyang*/ ston pas gsungs pa'i dmigs bsal dang*/ rang gis btags pa'i dmigs bsal gnyis ka'i thun mong du las la bskul bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// yang rtsa sngags kyi bsnyen pa song bas sbyin sreg la'ang rtsa sngags bsags dgos sam gsungs par/ lan ni/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum char gyi bsnyen pa bskyal bas sngags gsum gang rung zhig gis kha skong bsags pas chog la/ rtsa sngags kyi bsnyen pa gtso bor byed pas kha skong sbyin sreg gi til sngags kyang de nyid kyis bsags pa legs shing*/ khyad par drag po'i sbyin sreg la ni khyad par gyi rdzas rtsa sngags spel tshig can kho nas bsags pa nyid do// zhes rdo rje nag po chen po'i rtsa sngags kyi spel tshig sbyor tshul sogs kyi gsung lan rin chen snang gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni bla ma kun dga' bsod nams pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa bdud las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig/ ༈ /rdo rje 'chang sogs dngos brgyud bla ma'i bkas// brtse chen snying po'i bstan pa de 'dzin bcas// bsrung spel gnyer gtad mgon po dral lcam dang*// gdong bzhi dregs pas nyer mtshon bstan srung tshogs// gus pas mchod bstod reg gcod ral gri'i mchog

/phul bzhes sbyin bdag 'khor bcas byang chub bar// lam bzang sgrub pa'i bgegs dgra tshar bcad de// brtsams don thams cad 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// dge bas sdug bsngal rtsa ba gti mug brog /gcod byed shes rab ral gri cher gdengs pas// lam gyi bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal te// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal srid thob par shog /ces dge slong sangs rgyas bzang pos gan+dho la'i gtsug khang du ral gri phul ba'i 'dod gsol du/ gyi na bas bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
